title: Sunvault Climb - First Light at the Top
_note: Option C Light-forward / brightened variant. era gba (richer register, chords allowed). 116 BPM, 4/4, brilliant D major, 24 bars. Lead carries the ascending arpeggio melody, DOUBLED at the octave by a high bright bell for ascending sparkle (true-starlight Light signature). A secondary warm gba pad sustains underneath the climb for bloom; harp pluck arp continues over it. Strong forward walking bass. Full bright kit, crash/fill at the loop seam. Vesper motif reaches its highest statement — leap and settle an octave up, doubled in bell timbre, sparkling. Pre-echoes the Observatory's Light bells. ~6 voices (within gba's 8). Last bar A->D pickup voice-leads to bar 1.
